name: WORLD_CORE_V07_PACKAGE_CONTINUATION

continuation_rule.condition: The immediately preceding V07 step has an immutable candidate and complete normal-engineering evidence with applicable automated checks passing and no open P0 or MAJOR blocker, and every ADR required at the next step boundary is APPROVED.
continuation_rule.effect: The immediately following dependency-ready V07 step may start on codex/world-core-v07 without claiming verification.
continuation_rule.dependency_exception: An IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED dependency is accepted only between adjacent members of the exact allowed_steps sequence.

preserved_controls: V07 steps remain IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED unless independently promoted
normal engineering acceptance, determinism, idempotency, architecture, environment, security and governance checks remain mandatory
ADR-11 and ADR-17 are approved architecture
ADR-20 remains required before V07.2 queues a command
ADR-16 remains required before candidate DDL is merged or promoted
no database production mutation or migration publication
V07 package Review B and owner-controlled promotion remain mandatory before main merge or V08
prohibitions: continue across an unresolved ADR, P0 or MAJOR blocker
merge V07 to main before package Review B and merge authority
